scope.summary: Implement vector brushes as a single canonical StudioVectorBrush primitive with a discriminated kind field, applied either as a path stroke or via the brush/blob tools: Calligraphic (angle/roundness/size fixed/random/pressure), Scatter (distribute source-art copies with size/spacing/scatter/rotation variation), Art (stretch source art along path with direction/scale/non-stretch guides), Bristle (shape/length/density/thickness/opacity/stiffness), Pattern (side/corner/start/end tiles with fit/flip/auto-corners), Image/textured (raster-textured strokes on a vector spine), and Custom-from-art (capture a vector layer as a reusable brush).
acceptance_criteria: 7 canonical brush kinds under StudioVectorBrush; custom-from-art capture; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: brush panel reachable via author_id
test: calligraphic/scatter/art/bristle/pattern/image/custom kinds render along a spine; custom-from-art captures a vector layer as brush

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Vector brushes (calligraphic, scatter, art, bristle, pattern, image, custom)

risk_if_missed: No vector brushes; expressive stroke families missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
